record.title: KI Norge – joining forces for responsible and innovative artificial intelligence
record.summary: KI Norge is a national initiative within the Norwegian Digitalisation Agency (Digdir) that gives public and private organisations, especially small and medium-sized businesses, guidance on adopting AI in a safe, lawful and value-creating way, helping them understand the rules and find tools through ki.norge.no, with the aim of reducing risk. Together with the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet) and the Norwegian Communications Authority (Nkom) it runs the national AI sandbox, where organisations can develop, test and deploy AI systems within safe limits before wider use.
record.notes: The post of director was advertised on 11 Feb 2026, the appointment of Hans Christian Holte as director was announced on 7 May 2026, and KI Norge opened on 12 Jun 2026. The director is part of Digdir's top management group.
record.scope_note: An AI adoption and guidance body rather than an AI safety institute; included as Norway's main new institution for safe and responsible AI use, which also runs the national AI sandbox.

verification.note: Stored and read in this run: the Ministry of Digitalisation and Public Governance's press release of 12 Jun 2026 on the opening of KI Norge (regjeringen.no), which gives its mandate, its place within Digdir, its director and the national AI sandbox it runs with Datatilsynet and Nkom; and the ministry's press release of 11 Feb 2026 advertising the director post (stored as the secondary source), which describes the mandate and the sandbox and lists the press release of 7 May 2026 on the director's appointment. Both pages state that they are not available in English, and no English version was found. No founding decision or instruction for KI Norge is among the stored files.

summary.quote: KI Norge er en nasjonal satsing under Digitaliseringsdirektoratet.
Formålet er å gjøre det enklere for norske virksomheter å ta i bruk kunstig intelligens på en måte som er trygg, lovlig og verdiskapende.
Ki.norge.no skal gjøre det enklere for virksomheter, særlig små og mellomstore bedrifter, å forstå regelverk, finne relevante verktøy og komme i gang med KI på en trygg måte.
målet er å redusere risiko og gjøre det enklere å utnytte nye og kraftfulle verktøy
KI Norge skal gi veiledning og drifte den nasjonale KI-sandkassen sammen med Datatilsynet og Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet.
Sandkassen skal gi virksomheter mulighet til å utvikle, teste og ta i bruk KI-systemer innenfor trygge rammer før bredere bruk.

judgment.status_reasoning: KI Norge opened on 12 Jun 2026 ('KI Norge er klar', 'Nå åpner dørene!') as a standing initiative within Digdir; nothing stored says it has been wound up by 17 Oct 2026. 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A government body that advises organisations on safe and lawful AI use and runs the national AI sandbox with the data protection and communications authorities; borderline because its main task is adoption, so it keeps a scope_note.
